title: The Horror-Comedy Game That Topped Steam Scream Fest
summary: QUIET is a new co-op horror game that punishes you for being loud in real life. The Turtle Beach® Stealth™ 600 Headset pairs well by blocking ambient no...
body_markdown:
Lethal Company but you play as ducks. Need I say more? Well, yes! Because while that is an awesome concept on its own, there’s a lot to love about QUIET, a new online co-op horror-comedy game by LINE games that blasted off to #1 in the Top Demos category of Steam’s Scream V Fest in just under 24 hours. With 271,132 players from 148 countries, QUIET might just be the next global gaming sensation, but what is it, exactly?


Free to try on Steam and the Epic Games Store and fully releasing in Q1 2027, QUIET casts 1–4 players as alien ducks who must sneak through a house to collect spaceship parts in order to repair their broken ship and escape Earth. Normal so far. However, some dark and spooky things creep the halls of this (for some reason) spaceship-part-filled home, and those things are always listening. Each sound that you make —including the sounds that you, the player in real life, make— can alert the lurking evil. Let’s just say you’ll have bigger things to worry about than escaping Earth if you make too much noise.


In a strange twist, the game requires a microphone to play, but not explicitly for not talking into. Rather, the game monitors sounds in your real-life environment and punishes you if you get too loud. Remaining quiet is the name of the game (literally!), so the challenge is to not scream when the game tries to get you. But it’s not just you that needs to be quiet—you’d better tell your nosy roommates and pets to pipe down too! You’ve got ducks to save, after all!


Or, instead of worrying about things you can’t control, you could just use a headset that controls what you can’t. A headset with high-quality noise reduction blocks out distracting ambient noise for you so the sounds that really matter —your screams, yelps, and cries for help— will be the only things coming in loud and clear.


When it comes to being stealthy, the[Turtle Beach® Stealth™ series](https://www.turtlebeach.com/search?q=stealth) naturally has you covered. Take the[Stealth™ 600 Gen 3](https://www.turtlebeach.com/products/stealth-600-headset?Platform=XBOX&Color=Purple) , featuring a uni-directional, flip-to-mute microphone and AI noise reduction for the quietest background possible. With the Swarm™ II app, you can also customize your microphone & audio settings to your exact preference, allowing you to adjust microphone sensitivity, noise gate, monitoring levels, and more.


And by the way, these feel great to wear too. That’s because the[Stealth™ 600](https://www.turtlebeach.com/products/stealth-600-headset) feature a pressure relieving cushioned headband paired with memory foam ear cushions wrapped in soft athletic weave fabric. ProSpecs™ technology also means that, even if you’re a glasses-wearer who has felt fatigue around the temples from other headsets, this headset is still comfy during long sessions.
